Complies with ATX12V V3.0 & EPS12V V2.92
Updated ATX 3.0 specifications for the next-generation hardware power demands and ensure users get the most stable and cost-optimized performance possible with the highest power efficiency.
A dual forward topology integrated with active PFC and PWM technology and double EMI filter delivers full power and enhance stability to your system.
Stable DC to DC Output Quality
DC to DC modules with low ripple noise and prolongs system lifetime.
To reduce electromagnetic interference and suppress noise.
Hydro K PRO series is equipped with the 120mm hydraulic bearing fan (HYB) which makes optimum cooling and reduces noise. Moreover, the lifespan of fan is longer than standard one.
Designed for power-intensive VGA cards, provides strong power to any overloading condition.
With an 230V 80 Plus® rating, Hydro K PRO series delivers over 88% high efficiency.
Green Power! The total AC power consumption less than 5Vsb rail to meet the new EU Regulation ErP 2013 for modern systems.
